name: Acid
text: The corrosive spray of a black dragon's breath and the dissolving enzymes secreted by a black pudding deal acid damage.

name: Bludgeoning
text: Blunt force attacks, falling, constriction, and the like deal bludgeoning damage.

name: Cold
text: The infernal chill radiating from an ice devil's spear and the frigid blast of a white dragon's breath deal cold damage.

name: Fire
text: Red dragons breathe fire, and many spells conjure flames to deal fire damage.

name: Force
text: Force is pure magical energy focused into a damaging form. Most effects that deal force damage are spells, including magic missile and spiritual weapon.

name: Lightning
text: A lightning bolt spell and a blue dragon's breath deal lightning damage.

name: Necrotic
text: Necrotic damage, dealt by certain undead and a spell such as chill touch, withers matter and even the soul.

name: Piercing
text: Puncturing and impaling attacks, including spears and monsters' bites, deal piercing damage.

name: Poison
text: Venomous stings and the toxic gas of a green dragon's breath deal poison damage.

name: Psychic
text: Mental abilities such as a psionic blast deal psychic damage.

name: Radiant
text: Radiant damage, dealt by a cleric's flame strike spell or an angel's smiting weapon, sears the flesh like fire and overloads the spirit with power.

name: Slashing
text: Swords, axes, and monsters' claws deal slashing damage.

name: Thunder
text: A concussive burst of sound, such as the effect of the thunderwave spell, deals thunder damage.
